purpose: Regression fixtures for Vault Curator knowledge consolidation: detecting fragmented reusable models without flattening assessment boundaries, provenance, or Topic semantics.

notes: Separate short notes define runtime, orchestration, execution context, and tool-call control flow.
The notes repeatedly reconstruct the same execution mechanism and are retrieved together.

must: Identify a plausible shared retrieval target and governing mechanism.
Propose consolidation into a reusable mental model while preserving distinct terms as meaningful deltas or distinctions.
Preserve provenance and unique learner-specific corrections.
must_not: Keep duplicate active notes solely because their titles differ.
Treat note consolidation as mastery evidence.

notes: A Git branch note uses the word state.
An agent runtime note also uses the word state.

must: Check for a shared governing mechanism and retrieval target rather than lexical overlap.
Keep the notes separate when the underlying models answer different future questions.
must_not: Merge artifacts merely because they share vocabulary.

concepts: provider is assessed by identifying implementation ownership
adapter is assessed by designing translation across incompatible interfaces
initial_state.notes: Several explanatory notes can be synthesized into one component-boundary mental model.

must: Allow one explanatory note to synthesize the shared mental model.
Keep provider and adapter as separate Concepts when their assessment behaviors and failure modes differ.
must_not: Force Concept topology to mirror note topology.

concepts: two Concepts have different names but identical semantics
both are supported by the same kind of learner evidence and neither has a distinct prerequisite or failure mode

must: Recognize the Concepts as plausible duplicates rather than preserving glossary fragmentation.
Before mutation, map evidence, levelBasis, prerequisites, nextStepTargets, and references to a retained Concept.
must_not: Change mastery merely because duplicate Concepts are consolidated.

topics: Agent Capability Studio also uses runtime/control-flow foundations

must: Treat the shared foundation as a possible cross-Topic transfer relationship.
Preserve separate Topic boundaries when target capabilities remain distinct.
must_not: Merge Topics solely because they reuse the same foundation.

initial_state.notes: Several newly encountered memory-system terms appear related, but the learner has only exposure and the governing mechanism is still uncertain.

must: Report the possible consolidation candidate as uncertain or defer it.
Prefer an honest fragmented representation over a concise but unsupported abstraction.
must_not: Invent an invariant merely to reduce artifact count.

notes: Several agent memory methods share retrieval over stored experience.
They differ materially in construction timing, update policy, and interference behavior.

must: Preserve the common retrieval foundation only where valid.
Keep construction timing, update policy, and interference behavior as explicit meaningful deltas or separate retrieval units.
must_not: Flatten behaviorally important differences into one generic memory definition.

notes: One existing durable note already owns the runtime execution mental model.
Two later notes add small validated distinctions about tool result observation and state updates.

must: Prefer refining the existing owner when the new material serves the same retrieval target.
Preserve unique material and provenance before superseding duplicate active selections.
must_not: Create another synthesis note while leaving all overlapping notes active by default.

cases.learner_move: Review my Vault health and tell me whether my notes are fragmented.

must: Inspect and report consolidation candidates without mutating during the normal read-only review.
Provide an exact structural plan before any destructive or topology-changing write.
must_not: Automatically merge or delete notes because a candidate consolidation was found.

initial_state.notes: A reusable model has evolved across sessions and one older observation conflicts with the newer model.

must: Preserve relevant contradiction/history while consolidating the current retrieval model.
Keep evidence provenance independently auditable.
must_not: Erase contradictory evidence to make the consolidated note cleaner.
